text_block_list.text:
Fufu, just a little.
Last night was quite deep and eventful.

text_block_list.name: Maruzensky
text_block_list.text:
I found a shop that sells totally hip goods.
So I bought a disco ball for home!

text_block_list.name: Maruzensky
text_block_list.text: Thanks to that, it was a music fever worthy of a disco.
